tips.0: Every legend starts somewhere. Log one set to keep the fire alive.
tips.1: Consistency beats intensity. Show up today, even for 20 minutes.
tips.2: Progressive overload: add one rep or 2.5 kg when it starts feeling easy.
tips.3: Rest is training too — muscles grow between sessions, not during them.
tips.4: Warm up before heavy sets to protect your joints and lift more.
tips.5: Track every set. What gets measured gets improved.
tips.6: Protein within an hour after training speeds up recovery.
tips.7: Sleep is your strongest supplement — aim for 7 to 9 hours.
tips.8: Form first, weight second. Perfect reps build perfect strength.
tips.9: Hydrate: even 2% dehydration cuts your strength output.
